Definition: A unique ID in order for each location and time period
The name of the study area within UIC Student Center East
Example: First Floor Circle Lounge, Montgomery Lounge, Pier Room, East Terrace, West Terrace, Inner Circle, Commuter Center

Definition: The date of the observation in MM/DD/YYYY format
The time the observation took place in HH:MM format
The section of the day of the observation
Example: Morning (8:00–9:30 AM), Midday (12:30–1:30 PM), Afternoon (4:00–6:30 PM)

Definition: The temperature in Fahrenheit at the time of observation
The weather condition at the time of observation
The total amount of chairs available in the location
The total number of study tables available in the location
Number of chairs with a person or personal item at observation
Number of unoccupied chairs at observation using the formula (total_chairs − occupied_chairs)
Percentage of chairs that are occupied using the formula (occupied_chairs / total_chairs) × 100
Number of tables with at least one person or personal item in the chairs around the table
Number of tables with no people or personal items using the formula  (total_tables − occupied_tables)
Percentage of tables that are occupied using the formula (occupied_tables / total_tables) × 100
